# Top 8 chief technology officer resume samples

The document provides information about resume formats and samples for chief technology officers. It includes links to resume samples, tips for writing resumes and cover letters, interview questions and answers, and other job search resources on the resume123.org website. The document outlines 8 resume formats - chronological, functional, curriculum vitae, combination, targeted, professional, new graduate, and executive resumes. It also lists additional useful materials for chief technology officer interviews such as common interview questions, dress codes, and case study examples.
